primary_window: all valid scored 30-second epochs in recording
secondary_window: first to last scored sleep with 30-minute margins, reference-defined evaluation window only
unknown: movement/unscored excluded; context resets at gaps
point_model: frozen channel-shared BOAS model, no external fitting or adaptation
intervals: BOAS-calibrated intervals transported without recalibration; exchangeability under device/cohort shift not assumed
